plan: Lead Mega Gardevoir + Togekiss. Togekiss Follow Me absorbs Choice Band Hitmonlee, whose Fighting attacks are 0.25x into Fairy/Flying and 0.25x into Psychic/Fairy, so the whole opposing physical core is blanked while Pixilate Hyper Voice hits both slots and is 2x on Hitmonlee. Magearna is the Poison/Normal-resistant Steel/Fairy pivot; Nidoking covers Steel with Earth Power; Kartana answers Rock/Ground; Weavile supplies Fake Out and Knock Off against Eviolite/Choice Band items.
